name: duplicate_buy_on_existing_position
description: Repeated monitor cycles convert an already-open position into additional buy orders without a distinct add setup.
notes: UAL was bought eleven times and finished with -1.70% unrealized P&L despite multiple hold/no-duplicate warnings.

name: sympathy_confirmation_decay
description: A trade relies on a related confirmation symbol, then that confirmation fades while exposure in the primary symbol continues to rise.
notes: UAL long thesis depended on DAL maintaining gains, but DAL failed $85.80 and $86.20 repeatedly.

name: volume_filter_prevented_jbl_chase
description: A breakout watchlist name holds support but lacks required relative volume before an earnings catalyst, keeping the profile out.
notes: JBL stayed watch-only as relative volume remained 0.1x-0.7x before June 17 earnings; outcome remains pending rather than proven.
